subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should channel-visible turns without a canonical final-answer phase keep automatic multi-text fallback delivery, switch to final/last-segment-only delivery, or require explicit message-tool delivery?
rationale: The current behavior can leak internal narration to external channels, but changing it affects existing automatic bare-text reply workflows and may need an upgrade or opt-in policy.

options.title: Adopt final-only payload construction
options.body: Trim the no-canonical-final fallback at payload construction so interactive and cron delivery share one safer default, with any compatibility escape hatch documented and tested.

options.title: Require message-tool-owned channel replies
options.body: Move affected channel turns to explicit `message` sends, maximizing clarity but making a larger compatibility change for existing bare-text replies.

options.title: Keep automatic fallback with opt-in suppression
options.body: Accept the current default risk and add a configuration knob for operators who know their provider or channel leaks interim text.

recommendation.title: Adopt final-only payload construction
recommendation.body: Trim the no-canonical-final fallback at payload construction so interactive and cron delivery share one safer default, with any compatibility escape hatch documented and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a source-delivery product/security default decision, and steipete has the strongest history on the prior final-answer/commentary mitigation commits.
